stemBlocks: Oil of density $800 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$ is pumped through a pipe of circular cross-sectional area $0.60 \text{ m}^2$ at a speed of $5.0 \text{ m s}^{-1}$. Between X and Y, the cross-sectional area of the pipe decreases to $0.25 \text{ m}^2$.
What is the resultant force exerted on the oil as it passes from X to Y?
